title: legislation.gov.uk work catalogue and Atom feeds
jurisdictions: United Kingdom | England and Wales | Scotland | Northern Ireland
legal_force_or_role: Official publication metadata and work identities; legal force derives from each instrument, not the catalogue record.
corpus_boundary: All items exposed by the public legislation.gov.uk Atom catalogue, including primary, secondary, draft and EU-origin types represented by the source.
recommended_ingestion_method: Retain the present year-facet enumerated harvest as the legislation source-family pack; publish snapshot, request ledger and exact denominator.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Catalogue presence is not proof of complete text, revision, commencement or effect coverage. Some classes are metadata-only.

title: legislation.gov.uk CLML and selected-passage resources
jurisdictions: United Kingdom | England and Wales | Scotland | Northern Ireland
legal_force_or_role: Official text representation for the selected version; users must still establish commencement, extent and effects.
corpus_boundary: CLML for instruments and subdivisions where XML is held; some older instruments are PDF-only.
recommended_ingestion_method: Continue live progressive hydration; cache deterministically by canonical version URL and source hash, never by title alone.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Latest displayed text is not necessarily operative everywhere; XML is unavailable for some historical material.

title: legislation.gov.uk effects feeds
jurisdictions: United Kingdom | England and Wales | Scotland | Northern Ireland
legal_force_or_role: Official editorial records of amendments and other effects; an effect record supports change research but absence is not proof of no effect.
corpus_boundary: Affected and affecting feeds for instruments/provisions where effects have been recorded.
recommended_ingestion_method: Ingest as an evidence-bearing temporal graph with an explicit source-coverage qualifier on every derived “in force” conclusion.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Normally records amendments made from 1994 onwards; several legislation types have incomplete effect coverage.

title: legislation.gov.uk Publication Log
legal_force_or_role: Official publication-event feed; evidences publication, republication and withdrawal, not substantive legal effect by itself.
corpus_boundary: Events for legislation, drafts, associated documents, impact assessments and sets of changes.
recommended_ingestion_method: Use as incremental-refresh trigger, then re-fetch authoritative work/version/effect resources; never treat it as a complete historical audit log.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Some resources published before/around log launch lack events; published dates may not be true original publication dates.

title: legislation.gov.uk associated documents and impact assessments
owning_institution: The National Archives and originating departments
legal_force_or_role: Official explanatory/contextual material; not legislation unless separately enacted or made.
corpus_boundary: Associated documents linked from legislation metadata and Publication Log, including explanatory notes, memoranda and UK impact assessments where published.
recommended_ingestion_method: Discover from metadata and Publication Log, hydrate on demand, and label legal role explicitly as history/explanation.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Associated documents are uneven across periods/types; title alone is not a reliable type classifier.

title: legislation.gov.uk draft legislation catalogue
jurisdictions: United Kingdom | Scotland | Wales | Northern Ireland
legal_force_or_role: Draft material is non-operative unless and until enacted/made; it is evidence of legislative process and proposed text.
corpus_boundary: Draft statutory instruments and other draft types represented by official catalogue codes.
recommended_ingestion_method: Retain in legislation pack with a visually and semantically non-operative status.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: A draft title does not prove identity with a later made instrument.

title: legislation.gov.uk research bulk data and SPARQL surfaces
legal_force_or_role: Potential bulk/linked-data access to official corpus; authority remains with source records.
corpus_boundary: Research Legislation bulk collections and linked-data endpoint as documented by publisher.
recommended_ingestion_method: Register as a preferred future bulk lane but keep public Atom/CLML as the reproducible fallback.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Anonymous access restriction; operational and licensing terms may change.

title: legislation.gov.uk EU-origin, retained and assimilated law
owning_institution: The National Archives / Publications Office of the European Union
legal_force_or_role: Domestic legal status depends on UK withdrawal legislation and subsequent amendments; EU source remains essential for origin/history.
corpus_boundary: EU legal acts, consolidations, corrigenda and selected treaties published under the statutory UK publication duty.
recommended_ingestion_method: Keep UK operative/discovery records in the legislation pack and federate to EUR-Lex/CELLAR for source history and multilingual manifestations.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: UK publication is not a substitute for full EUR-Lex historical/preparatory coverage; legal status is not inferable from document presence.

title: Find Case Law public service
owning_institution: The National Archives with MoJ, HMCTS and Judicial Office
jurisdictions: England and Wales | United Kingdom for UKSC/JCPC
legal_force_or_role: Official free publication of judgments/decisions; precedential force depends on court, issue, date and later treatment.
corpus_boundary: England-and-Wales courts/tribunals received for publication plus UKSC and Privy Council; excludes Scottish and Northern Irish courts/tribunals.
recommended_ingestion_method: Harvest metadata and permitted text only under the applicable licence; maintain per-court coverage ledger and live-source verification.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Not all decisions are written or sent; lower-court coverage is selective; appeal status may not be linked; no Scotland/NI corpus.

title: Find Case Law API and computational-analysis licence
jurisdictions: England and Wales | United Kingdom for UKSC/JCPC
legal_force_or_role: Machine access to the official case-law publication; does not alter legal force.
corpus_boundary: API access to Find Case Law records; bulk computational analysis is separately licensed.
access_statuses: documented but not tested | verified working
recommended_ingestion_method: Create a licence-gated adapter with a no-text public-metadata mode and explicit feature flags.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: No licence was obtained or exercised during this research; therefore no bulk operational claim is made.

title: Find Case Law Supreme Court collection
owning_institution: The National Archives / UK Supreme Court
legal_force_or_role: Final appellate authority subject to jurisdictional limits; substantive judgment is authoritative, press summary is not.
corpus_boundary: All substantive UKSC judgments since establishment according to the official court coverage page.
recommended_ingestion_method: Use as the first court-level denominator pilot and reconciliation test against UKSC’s own site.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: House of Lords decisions before 2009 are separate archival sources; appeal/citator relationships still need enrichment.

title: Find Case Law lower-court and tribunal collections
legal_force_or_role: Authority varies by court/tribunal; decisions may be binding, persuasive or fact-specific.
corpus_boundary: Court-specific collections including appellate/high courts, upper tribunals and selected lower courts/first-tier tribunals.
recommended_ingestion_method: One source-family adapter, but separate coverage-ledger rows and acceptance thresholds per court/chamber.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Crown/County/Family/first-tier coverage can be highly selective; verbal judgments may never be transcribed.

title: Scottish Courts and Tribunals Service judgments
legal_force_or_role: Official Scottish judgments; authority depends on court and subject.
corpus_boundary: Published judgments/opinions selected for publication, with searchable material mainly from 1999 and separate feeds.
recommended_ingestion_method: Federate as a distinct jurisdictional pack; do not merge records solely by party names.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Not all decisions are published; coverage and identifiers differ from Find Case Law; no unified UK denominator.

title: Judiciary NI judgments
owning_institution: Judiciary NI / Courts and Tribunals Service
legal_force_or_role: Official Northern Ireland judgments; force depends on court and issue.
corpus_boundary: Published judgments and decisions made available by the Northern Ireland judiciary.
recommended_ingestion_method: Metadata-first adapter plus on-demand PDF/HTML passage extraction; keep coverage unknown/partial until official enumeration is established.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: No official complete denominator or machine API verified; coverage may be selective.

title: BAILII case-law database
owning_institution: British and Irish Legal Information Institute
legal_force_or_role: Valuable free secondary publication; not the official publisher for most records and coverage is uneven.
corpus_boundary: Multi-jurisdiction database of judgments, tribunal decisions and legislation supplied from varied sources.
recommended_ingestion_method: Use only as a secondary discovery/legacy-coverage lane with explicit publisher status and source reconciliation.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Not official for most cases; missing/corrected records and duplicate identities are possible; tested access failed.

title: UK Supreme Court and Judicial Committee websites
owning_institution: UK Supreme Court / Judicial Committee of the Privy Council
jurisdictions: United Kingdom | Commonwealth/overseas jurisdictions for JCPC
legal_force_or_role: Court-published judgments and orders; press summaries are explanatory and not part of the judgment.
corpus_boundary: Judgments, case details, hearing information, press summaries and related documents on the courts’ own websites.
access_statuses: verified working | documented but not tested
recommended_ingestion_method: Use for reconciliation, case metadata and related materials; canonical judgment passage should prefer FCL where available.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Potential duplicates with FCL; press summaries must never be treated as authoritative holdings.

title: The National Archives Discovery legal records
legal_force_or_role: Archival catalogue/records; evidential role depends on the record, not catalogue metadata.
corpus_boundary: Paper and digitised historical legal, court, parliamentary and government records transferred to TNA.
recommended_ingestion_method: Discovery-only federation with explicit “archival/non-current” role and no automatic passage claims.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Catalogue presence does not mean digital text; legal status and current authority require separate research.

title: Civil Procedure Rules and practice directions
owning_institution: Ministry of Justice / Civil Procedure Rule Committee
legal_force_or_role: Procedural rules and directions governing civil proceedings; precise force depends on rule, practice direction and enabling legislation.
corpus_boundary: Current CPR parts, practice directions, pre-action protocols, forms links and update instruments published on GOV.UK/Justice.
recommended_ingestion_method: Harvest structured HTML into a procedure pack; verify currency against latest amending SI and update notice at answer time.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Online consolidation can lag a newly made amendment; historical versions are not consistently exposed as structured data.

title: Criminal Procedure Rules and practice directions
owning_institution: Ministry of Justice / Criminal Procedure Rule Committee / Judiciary
legal_force_or_role: Procedural rules and judicial directions for criminal proceedings.
corpus_boundary: Current criminal procedure rules, practice directions and amendments.
recommended_ingestion_method: Metadata catalogue plus version-addressed documents; link every deadline/procedure proposition to rule or direction passage.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Historical version reconstruction is non-trivial; directions may appear on judiciary and GOV.UK surfaces.

title: Family Procedure Rules and practice directions
owning_institution: Ministry of Justice / Family Procedure Rule Committee
legal_force_or_role: Procedural rules and directions governing family proceedings.
corpus_boundary: Current FPR parts, practice directions, forms and update material.
recommended_ingestion_method: Procedure-family adapter sharing the civil-rule parser but retaining distinct jurisdiction/force.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Some forms/guidance live on separate HMCTS pages; historical versions are not uniform.

title: Tribunal Procedure Rules and practice directions
owning_institution: Ministry of Justice / Tribunal Procedure Committee / Judiciary
legal_force_or_role: Procedural rules for tribunal chambers; applicability is chamber- and jurisdiction-specific.
corpus_boundary: Rules and practice directions for First-tier and Upper Tribunal chambers and related bodies.
recommended_ingestion_method: Model each chamber separately and link to tribunal competence/reference data.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Rules, forms and chamber guidance can be split across multiple sites; UK-wide applicability varies.

title: Judiciary practice directions and guidance
legal_force_or_role: Judicial directions/guidance; force must be classified per document and relationship to procedural rules.
corpus_boundary: Practice directions, guidance, protocols and judicial office publications.
recommended_ingestion_method: Discovery and on-demand hydration with mandatory force/supersession review before use.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Search/category taxonomy is not a legal-force taxonomy; duplicate/superseded PDFs can persist.

title: HMCTS forms
jurisdictions: England and Wales | United Kingdom for some tribunals
legal_force_or_role: Official procedural forms and service information; form revision and required use depend on relevant rule/Practice Direction.
corpus_boundary: Court and tribunal forms published through GOV.UK and linked collections.
recommended_ingestion_method: Metadata harvest; download on demand; warn whenever cached form revision differs from live source.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Collection does not by itself prove mandatory/current use in a particular proceeding.

title: HMCTS court and tribunal fees
owning_institution: HM Courts & Tribunals Service / Ministry of Justice
jurisdictions: England and Wales | United Kingdom for some tribunals
legal_force_or_role: Official fee information; legal obligation ultimately rests on fee orders and exemptions/remission rules.
corpus_boundary: Current fee tables, guidance and help-with-fees information.
recommended_ingestion_method: Local metadata for discovery, mandatory live verification and legislation link before presenting a payable amount.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Guidance can simplify exceptions and is not a substitute for the operative fee order in disputed cases.

title: Court and Tribunal Hearings Service (CaTH) data
legal_force_or_role: Operational listing data; not a legal authority and highly time-sensitive.
corpus_boundary: Raw hearing/listing data published via CaTH to approved third-party licensees.
recommended_ingestion_method: Do not include in early static bundle. Add a separately authorised, non-cache-by-default live provider lane only after DPIA/licence/security review.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Not public bulk data; high volatility; inclusion could expose personal/sensitive information if mishandled.

title: Find a Court or Tribunal service
jurisdictions: England and Wales | some UK-wide tribunal services
legal_force_or_role: Official service-location and contact information; not legal authority.
corpus_boundary: Public directory of courts/tribunals, addresses, facilities, opening times and service information.
recommended_ingestion_method: Provider datapack/live-link model with an explicit operational-currentness warning.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: No complete historical record or public API verified; names may differ from legal institutional identities.

title: Sentencing Council guidelines
owning_institution: Sentencing Council for England and Wales
legal_force_or_role: Definitive guidelines engage statutory sentencing duties; legal application depends on offence, date and exceptions.
corpus_boundary: Definitive guidelines, overarching guidance, consultations and archived/superseded versions where published.
recommended_ingestion_method: Harvest metadata and structured headings, retain versioned content, and make effective-date selection mandatory.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Current page may not apply to historical conduct; offence/category mappings need expert review.

title: Crown Prosecution Service legal guidance
legal_force_or_role: Official prosecution policy/guidance; not legislation and does not bind courts, though it guides CPS decision-making.
corpus_boundary: CPS legal guidance topics, charging standards and prosecution policy materials.
recommended_ingestion_method: Metadata and versioned snapshot where licence permits; label as official guidance and link controlling authorities separately.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Guidance is not controlling authority; archived versions and local policies may be absent.

title: COPFS Prosecution Code and guidance
owning_institution: Crown Office and Procurator Fiscal Service
legal_force_or_role: Official Scottish prosecution code/policy; not a substitute for legislation or judicial authority.
corpus_boundary: Prosecution Code, disclosure code and subject guidance published by COPFS.
recommended_ingestion_method: Scottish prosecution source-family adapter with source/date snapshots and explicit non-binding label.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Guidance does not establish court outcome; historic policies may need archive research.

title: Public Prosecution Service NI Code for Prosecutors
owning_institution: Public Prosecution Service for Northern Ireland
legal_force_or_role: Official prosecution policy for Northern Ireland; not binding judicial authority.
corpus_boundary: Code for Prosecutors, prosecution process and policy publications.
recommended_ingestion_method: Northern Ireland guidance pack with versioned documents and controlling-authority links.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Policy is not law; historic editions may not remain linked.

title: FCA Handbook
legal_force_or_role: Mix of binding rules, evidential provisions, guidance and sourcebooks; each provision’s type and legal basis must be preserved.
corpus_boundary: FCA Handbook modules, instruments, guidance and related materials.
recommended_ingestion_method: Start metadata-only with live links and source-status monitoring; add licensed/terms-compliant snapshot after explicit permission review.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Direct access failed in this test; rules and guidance can be visually adjacent; online consolidation may require instrument verification.

title: FCA enforcement and notices
legal_force_or_role: Final notices and decisions have formal legal/regulatory effect for the named matter; press releases are contextual.
corpus_boundary: Final notices, decision notices where publishable, warning notices statements, enforcement actions and outcomes.
recommended_ingestion_method: Metadata-first ingestion with on-demand notice PDFs and explicit decision/press-release distinction.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Search categories may omit older or migrated notices; press summaries cannot replace the formal notice.

title: PRA Rulebook
owning_institution: Prudential Regulation Authority / Bank of England
legal_force_or_role: PRA rules are binding on relevant firms; the online Rulebook is a consolidation and legal instruments remain definitive for amendment history.
corpus_boundary: PRA Rulebook parts, policy material and legal instruments.
recommended_ingestion_method: Rulebook adapter with explicit provision type and instrument-backed temporal graph.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Online consolidation is convenient but legal instruments are definitive; guidance and rules must not be flattened.

title: Ofcom rules, codes and regulatory statements
legal_force_or_role: Mixture of statutory codes, conditions, decisions and guidance; force depends on statutory basis and document type.
corpus_boundary: Broadcasting/communications/online-safety codes, general conditions, statements, consultations and guidance.
recommended_ingestion_method: Regime-specific packs sharing a regulator core model; preserve consultation-to-final lineage.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Search/topic pages mix consultation, statement, rule and guidance; legal-force classification is essential.

title: Ofcom enforcement decisions
legal_force_or_role: Formal decisions/notices may impose or record regulatory consequences; news summaries are contextual.
corpus_boundary: Enforcement cases, sanctions, breach findings and related notices across Ofcom regimes.
recommended_ingestion_method: Model enforcement lifecycle and hydrate final formal documents before answer synthesis.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Open/closed status and appeal outcomes can be on separate pages.

title: ICO statutory guidance, codes and regulatory guidance
legal_force_or_role: Includes statutory codes/guidance and non-statutory regulatory explanation; force must be stated per publication.
corpus_boundary: Data protection, freedom of information, PECR and AI guidance/codes.
recommended_ingestion_method: Guidance pack with explicit statutory-basis field and live-source drift checks.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Guidance may not reflect pending law/cases immediately; statutory and non-statutory force differs.

title: ICO decision notices and enforcement action
legal_force_or_role: Decision notices and enforcement instruments have defined statutory effects and appeal routes; case summaries are secondary.
corpus_boundary: FOI/EIR decision notices, enforcement notices, monetary penalties and undertakings.
recommended_ingestion_method: Ingest notice metadata and final documents; reconcile appeals with tribunal/case-law packs.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Appeal status and later case law may not be linked; search metadata varies across years.

title: Competition and Markets Authority cases and decisions
legal_force_or_role: Formal decisions/orders/undertakings have legal effects; consultations and press releases are contextual.
corpus_boundary: Merger, antitrust, consumer, market-study and subsidy cases, decisions and guidance.
recommended_ingestion_method: Case-lifecycle adapter with typed document roles and appeal links.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Case pages mix binding decisions, evidence, consultation and press material.

title: Environment Agency enforcement and sanctions publications
legal_force_or_role: Formal sanctions/notices have statutory effects; published summaries may be selective.
corpus_boundary: Enforcement undertakings, sanctions and prosecutions published by the Environment Agency.
recommended_ingestion_method: Treat each published register as a bounded dataset with its own denominator and retention policy.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Coverage is regime-specific and may not include every enforcement action.

title: Local Government and Social Care Ombudsman decisions
owning_institution: Local Government and Social Care Ombudsman
legal_force_or_role: Findings/recommendations under the ombudsman scheme; not court precedent, though public bodies usually comply.
corpus_boundary: Published decision statements and investigation reports relating to local government and social care.
recommended_ingestion_method: Metadata harvest with retention-aware coverage ledger; never derive a complete complaint history.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Not all decisions published; time-limited retention means historical absence is not evidence of no decision.

title: Parliamentary and Health Service Ombudsman case decisions
jurisdictions: United Kingdom for parliamentary complaints | England for health service complaints
legal_force_or_role: Ombudsman findings/recommendations; not judicial precedent.
corpus_boundary: Published case decisions, case summaries and reports.
recommended_ingestion_method: Metadata-first pack with explicit “published investigated cases” boundary and period split.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Pre-April-2021 public material is selected, not complete; not all cases are investigated/published.

title: Scottish Public Services Ombudsman decisions and reviews
legal_force_or_role: Ombudsman decisions/recommendations and Scottish Welfare Fund reviews; not judicial precedent.
corpus_boundary: Decision reports, summaries and Scottish Welfare Fund review decisions.
recommended_ingestion_method: Separate ombudsman decision and welfare-fund review subtypes; preserve scheme/legal basis.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Publication does not equal all complaints; separate schemes have different force and review routes.

title: Northern Ireland Public Services Ombudsman findings
legal_force_or_role: Ombudsman findings/recommendations under Northern Ireland legislation; not court precedent.
corpus_boundary: Investigation reports, public interest reports and own-initiative materials.
recommended_ingestion_method: Metadata harvest, on-demand PDF extraction and explicit publication-boundary statement.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Not every complaint results in a published report; search structure may change.

title: UK Parliament Bills service
legal_force_or_role: Official legislative-process material; Bill text is proposed law until enacted.
corpus_boundary: Public and private Bills, versions, stages, amendments, explanatory notes and related documents.
recommended_ingestion_method: Harvest metadata and version links; keep stage/version lineage and link enacted legislation by evidence.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: A Bill title/version does not prove enacted text; amendments may be proposed, withdrawn or disagreed.

title: Hansard official report
legal_force_or_role: Official report of parliamentary proceedings; relevant to history and, in limited legal contexts, interpretation, but not legislation.
corpus_boundary: Commons, Lords and Westminster Hall debates and written statements on the current Hansard service.
recommended_ingestion_method: Metadata and passage-level speech index with source gaps exposed; no automatic “legislative intent” conclusion.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Current site documents missing 2004–2006 content; Hansard is not a statement of enacted law.

title: UK Parliament committees, evidence and reports
legal_force_or_role: Official scrutiny/evidence/reports; recommendations and witness evidence are not binding law.
corpus_boundary: Select committee inquiries, oral/written evidence, reports, government responses and publications.
recommended_ingestion_method: Ingest inquiry/document graph and retain role labels for report, evidence and response.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Evidence can be unverified/opinion; committee recommendations are not law.

title: UK Parliament Statutory Instrument tracker
legal_force_or_role: Official parliamentary scrutiny information; does not replace the made instrument or parliamentary procedure law.
corpus_boundary: SI scrutiny status, deadlines and links to instrument/explanatory material.
recommended_ingestion_method: Federate to legislation work IDs and store tracker observations as temporal procedural events.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Coverage scope and historical retention require explicit ledgering; legal effect depends on instrument and procedure.

title: Scottish Parliament Bills and Official Report
legal_force_or_role: Official devolved legislative-process material; Bills are proposed law and Official Report is history.
corpus_boundary: Bills, amendments, stages, committee material, Official Report and explanatory/financial memoranda.
recommended_ingestion_method: Devolved parliamentary adapter sharing core Bill/Stage/Document model but retaining native identifiers.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: No single cross-UK Bill identity; enacted link must be evidenced.

title: Senedd Cymru legislation and Record of Proceedings
legal_force_or_role: Official Welsh legislative-process material; Bills are proposed law and proceedings are history.
corpus_boundary: Bills, amendments, explanatory memoranda, committee scrutiny and Record of Proceedings.
recommended_ingestion_method: Bilingual-first adapter with language-tagged expressions and enacted-work reconciliation.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: English and Welsh versions must not be conflated; explanatory material is non-operative.

title: Northern Ireland Assembly Bills and Official Report
legal_force_or_role: Official devolved legislative-process material; Bills are proposed law and proceedings are history.
corpus_boundary: Bills, stages, committee scrutiny, Official Report and related documents.
recommended_ingestion_method: Native adapter with explicit Assembly-term/status and enacted-work reconciliation.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Institutional suspension periods and legacy site migrations affect continuity.

title: Law Commission publications and projects
owning_institution: Law Commission of England and Wales
legal_force_or_role: Official independent law-reform analysis and recommendations; not law until implemented.
corpus_boundary: Projects, consultations, reports, draft Bills, government responses and implementation information.
recommended_ingestion_method: Project graph linking consultations, reports, government responses and enacted implementation.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Recommendations may be partial, rejected or superseded; implementation status needs legislation links.

title: Scottish Law Commission publications
legal_force_or_role: Official Scottish law-reform analysis and recommendations; not law until implemented.
corpus_boundary: Discussion papers, reports, draft Bills, consultations and project information.
recommended_ingestion_method: Scottish law-reform pack aligned to common project/publication model.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Search count is not necessarily a stable denominator; implementation may occur through Scottish or UK legislation.

title: Public inquiry reports and recommendation tracking
owning_institution: Cabinet Office / sponsoring departments / inquiry chairs
jurisdictions: United Kingdom | devolved jurisdictions where applicable
legal_force_or_role: Official inquiry findings/recommendations; legal force depends on implementing action, not report publication alone.
corpus_boundary: Statutory/non-statutory inquiry websites, reports, evidence, rulings and government recommendation tracking.
recommended_ingestion_method: Central discovery register plus per-inquiry adapters; never infer implementation from “accepted” without downstream evidence.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: No complete central catalogue; inquiry evidence may be restricted, redacted or removed.

title: Official accident investigation reports (AAIB, RAIB, MAIB)
legal_force_or_role: Official safety investigation findings/recommendations; not determinations of civil or criminal liability.
corpus_boundary: Published aviation, rail and marine accident reports, bulletins and recommendations.
access_statuses: verified working | verified working | verified working
recommended_ingestion_method: Typed investigation pack with explicit non-liability role and recommendation-response graph.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Reports explicitly do not apportion blame/legal liability; branch archives differ.

title: UK Treaties Online and treaty dataset
legal_force_or_role: Official UK treaty records; legal effect depends on signature/ratification/entry into force and domestic implementation.
corpus_boundary: UK bilateral/multilateral treaty records, command papers and treaty series, around 15,000 records according to publisher.
recommended_ingestion_method: Ingest official CSV metadata, hydrate documents on demand, and link domestic implementing legislation separately.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Domestic legal effect is not inferable from treaty status alone; UKTO advises checking depositary for current status.

title: EUR-Lex
owning_institution: Publications Office of the European Union
legal_force_or_role: Official EU legal database; relevance/force in UK law depends on domestic status and temporal context.
corpus_boundary: EU legislation, treaties, case law, preparatory acts, Official Journal and consolidated texts.
access_statuses: verified working | authenticated or restricted | verified working
recommended_ingestion_method: Federated metadata plus CELLAR-backed bulk lane; never mirror all multilingual content into browser startup.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Consolidated text is usually documentary convenience, not a new legal act; UK relevance requires domestic mapping.

title: CELLAR repository and APIs
owning_institution: Publications Office of the European Union
legal_force_or_role: Official repository/dissemination infrastructure for EU publications and metadata.
corpus_boundary: Content and metadata underpinning EUR-Lex and other EU portals.
access_statuses: verified working | documented but not tested
recommended_ingestion_method: Server-side bulk/graph ingestion for selected UK-relevant sectors, publishing compact indexes to OKF.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Complex CDM model; service endpoints and caps can change; UK use requires relevance filtering.

title: HUDOC European Court of Human Rights database
owning_institution: European Court of Human Rights / Council of Europe
jurisdictions: Council of Europe | United Kingdom relevance
legal_force_or_role: ECtHR judgments bind respondent states under the Convention framework; domestic interpretive effect requires UK-law context.
corpus_boundary: Judgments, decisions, communicated cases, legal summaries and related materials in HUDOC.
recommended_ingestion_method: Metadata harvest under terms, live paragraph verification, and explicit UK relevance/Convention status.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Translations/legal summaries are not always authoritative; historical omissions and document-status distinctions matter.

title: The Gazette
owning_institution: The Stationery Office under authority of HM Government
jurisdictions: United Kingdom | England and Wales | Scotland | Northern Ireland
legal_force_or_role: Official permanent public record; particular notice legal effects derive from the governing statute/process.
corpus_boundary: London, Edinburgh and Belfast Gazette notices including insolvency, company, planning, honours and public appointments.
recommended_ingestion_method: Use API/RDF for metadata, preserve permanent URL and digital-signature evidence, hydrate notice text on demand.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: A notice is evidence of publication, not necessarily proof that all substantive conditions were met or remain current.

title: Local authority byelaws and local legal publications
owning_institution: Local authorities and other byelaw-making bodies
legal_force_or_role: Locally made rules with force of law within their enabling power and geographic area.
corpus_boundary: Byelaws, local schemes, orders and registers published across hundreds of local/public bodies.
access_statuses: verified working | documented but not tested
recommended_ingestion_method: Discovery ledger per authority; metadata-only until an authoritative document/register is found; never claim national completeness.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: No central record, uneven digitisation, revocation gaps, ambiguous local identifiers.

title: Legal Aid Agency eligibility and service information
owning_institution: Legal Aid Agency / Ministry of Justice
legal_force_or_role: Official eligibility and access information; individual entitlement depends on law, means/merits and case facts.
corpus_boundary: Civil/criminal legal aid eligibility, calculators, provider finding, exceptional case funding and forms.
recommended_ingestion_method: Discovery and rule-source links only; no automated entitlement conclusion without facts and escalation.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Simplified service questions do not resolve every legal-aid entitlement; Scotland/NI use separate systems.

title: Scottish Legal Aid Board information
legal_force_or_role: Official Scottish legal-aid service information; entitlement is fact- and scheme-dependent.
corpus_boundary: Eligibility, applications, solicitor/provider information and practitioner guidance.
recommended_ingestion_method: Separate jurisdiction pack and escalation to SLAB/qualified adviser for entitlement decisions.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: No cross-UK equivalence; guidance does not substitute for regulations or case assessment.

title: Legal aid and public legal assistance in Northern Ireland
owning_institution: Department of Justice NI / Legal Services Agency NI
legal_force_or_role: Official Northern Ireland legal-aid/service information; entitlement depends on local legislation and facts.
corpus_boundary: Legal aid guidance, forms, provider and scheme information.
recommended_ingestion_method: Northern Ireland service-information pack with controlling-legislation links and human escalation.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: No UK-wide harmonisation; guidance can be simplified.

title: GOV.UK and devolved public legal guidance
owning_institution: Government Digital Service and responsible public bodies
jurisdictions: United Kingdom | England and Wales | Scotland | Northern Ireland
legal_force_or_role: Official public explanation/service guidance; not controlling law unless the page itself publishes a statutory instrument/code.
corpus_boundary: Rights, obligations, process and service guidance across GOV.UK, mygov.scot, GOV.WALES and nidirect.
access_statuses: verified working | verified working | verified working | verified working
recommended_ingestion_method: Discovery and plain-language layer linked to authoritative sources; never rank above controlling authority.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Guidance may simplify, omit exceptions or lag legal change; platforms cover different competencies.

title: Bar Standards Board Handbook and decisions
legal_force_or_role: Regulatory rules for barristers/entities under statutory regulatory framework; guidance/decisions have distinct roles.
corpus_boundary: BSB Handbook, rule changes, guidance, disciplinary/enforcement decisions and sanctions.
recommended_ingestion_method: Professional-regulator pack with provision type and version model shared with FCA/PRA adapters.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Guidance and mandatory rules can be adjacent; decision registers may have retention limits.

title: SRA Standards and Regulations and decisions
legal_force_or_role: Regulatory requirements for solicitors/firms; guidance and disciplinary decisions have distinct force.
corpus_boundary: Standards and Regulations, guidance, waivers, disciplinary decisions and interventions.
recommended_ingestion_method: Regulator model with privacy-aware person/entity records and time-bounded decision state.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Register results are operationally current and may not provide full historical context; rules vs guidance must be distinguished.

title: Judicial and tribunal office reference sources
owning_institution: Judicial Office / HMCTS / devolved judicial bodies
jurisdictions: United Kingdom | England and Wales | Scotland | Northern Ireland
legal_force_or_role: Official reference information about courts, tribunals and office-holders; not substantive law.
corpus_boundary: Court/tribunal descriptions, jurisdiction, judiciary lists and organisational structure.
recommended_ingestion_method: Curated authority registry with temporal identities, source citations and no automatic sameAs from labels.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Names are not stable identifiers; court reorganisations and acting appointments complicate identity.

title: Official law reports and ICLR platform
owning_institution: Incorporated Council of Law Reporting for England and Wales
legal_force_or_role: Authorised law reports are highly significant for citation practice; the reporter/editorial apparatus is not an official government source and access is partly commercial.
corpus_boundary: Law reports, case summaries, citations and citator/editorial services.
recommended_ingestion_method: Metadata-only optional connector, never a required public-core dependency; licensed integration as a separate provider.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Not freely or wholly reusable; editorial treatment must not be represented as official court metadata.

title: Westlaw UK and Lexis+ legal research services
legal_force_or_role: Commercial editorial databases/citators; valuable but not official sources of legal authority.
corpus_boundary: Legislation, case law, citator treatment, commentary, forms and journals under subscription.
recommended_ingestion_method: Document as optional licensed connectors and a gap in public citator capability, not as a core ingestion source.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Unavailable as public open data; treatment signals cannot be copied into open bundle without rights.

title: UK Web Archive legal and government collections
owning_institution: The National Archives / British Library partners
legal_force_or_role: Archived web evidence; not necessarily current or authoritative at the time of use.
corpus_boundary: Captured government, regulatory, inquiry and legal websites that have changed or closed.
recommended_ingestion_method: Use as historical fallback with prominent capture date and no live-currentness inference.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Capture gaps; replay may omit scripts/assets; archived guidance is not current.

title: Devolved government statutory guidance and regulatory publications
owning_institution: Scottish Government / Welsh Government / Northern Ireland departments
legal_force_or_role: Statutory guidance, directions and policy documents whose legal force depends on local enabling law.
corpus_boundary: Cross-department devolved guidance, circulars, codes and regulatory documents.
access_statuses: verified working | verified working | verified working
recommended_ingestion_method: Classifier-assisted discovery but human-reviewed authority/force typing before publication.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Publication catalogues mix binding directions, statutory guidance, policy and consultation.

title: Official public-body register and organisation data
owning_institution: GOV.UK / responsible administrations / Companies House where relevant
legal_force_or_role: Reference data about public bodies and organisations; not proof of legal competence without founding/empowering source.
corpus_boundary: Government organisation pages, public bodies lists, departmental roles and related identifiers.
recommended_ingestion_method: Curated institution registry linked to legislation and source records with temporal lineage.
known_omissions_or_inconsistencies: Directory membership does not establish every statutory power; identity changes create duplicates.
